title: Lifts of cycles in tropical hypersurfaces and the Gamma conjecture
summary: For a complex hypersurface of dimension $d \geq 1$ in a toric variety, we construct lifts of tropical $(p, q)$-cycles with $p+q=d$ in the associated tropical hypersurface. The tropical cycles we consider are described by Minkowski weights, and their lifts are realized as topological cycles admitting a torus fibration structure over the tropical cycles. The intersection numbers of these lifted cycles are computed in terms of tropical intersection theory.
